title: Peacemaking
definition: Peacemaking is the faithful pursuit of peace through truth, love, humility, repentance, forgiveness, and righteousness.
summary: Peacemaking is not avoiding truth or pretending conflict does not exist. Biblical peace is rooted in righteousness and shaped by the Gospel.
christFocus: Christ made peace through His blood and calls His people to reflect His reconciling grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Peacemaking is not avoiding truth or pretending conflict does not exist. Biblical peace is rooted in righteousness and shaped by the Gospel.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
